why: Let authors create more open vegetation with the nature brush instead of individually thinning dense clusters.
semantics: Full preserves previous catalog spacing. Open and Sparse increase separation, with a one-cell baseline before multiplying so low ground plants also change density. Existing plants are never removed or rescaled.
checks: density spacing, native validity and deterministic output
trusted sparse brush matches plan with exact atomic undo/redo
bounds, spacing, camp and size rejection
copy and Delete with exact undo
erase tool removes only one object
trusted drag move and Escape cancellation
visualObservation: The actual sparse macambira brush result leaves clear gaps, avoids the existing camp/buildings and keeps normal sprite scale. Density control fits the desktop tool panel and is restored after reload.
limits: Counts are fixture-specific, not promised density percentages.
Brush still uses cell-aligned anchors; this does not establish natural irregular cluster composition or complete landscape-art acceptance.
No new raster artwork, simulation rules, automatic generation density or release-wide performance claim.
